researcher_notes: CALIBRATION RUN. Sterimove is a NEW PRODUCT for an existing company (Stäubli already in DB with FL1500, PF280, PF3, PF30, PF6). IMPORTANT FLAG: the datasheet itself is explicitly marked 'Preliminary data' on both the cover page and the dimensions page, and carries a disclaimer 'We reserve the right to modify product specifications without prior notice' -- this is pre-release/subject-to-change data, not a finalized product spec. Recommend the reviewer treat these values as provisional and re-verify before using them as hard K.O. thresholds. The PDF's dimensioned CAD drawing pages (p.2 bottom half) are heavily corrupted/garbled by the text extraction (interleaved German bolt-torque instructions and drawing-frame text merged into one unreadable block) -- only the clean spec table at the top of p.2 was used; no attempt was made to visually re-read the CAD drawing for this calibration run since all KO-relevant values (payload, speed, turning radius) were already legible in the clean table text. ADDENDUM (later in same continuation run): 'Mobile-Robotics-portfolio-EN.pdf' (company-wide product catalog) processed -- surfaced the PF3/PF3 OMNI naming ambiguity noted on the PF3 entry above; no other new numeric fields found (FL1500/PF3/PF6 headline figures all already known). 'Training-brochure-mobile robotics-EN.pdf' (company-wide training-services brochure) processed -- contains no product specifications at all (training curriculum only), moved to Analysed with zero fields extracted.

products.notes: ADDENDUM (continuation run, same calendar day). This product is classified Mobile AMR in the DB (unlike its sibling FL1500, classified Forklift AGV), so the AMR-scope min_turning_radius/min_ground_clearance KO fields both apply and were filled directly from this datasheet's own explicit 'radius'/'ground clearance' wording -- no ambiguity, unlike the recurring radius-vs-diameter question flagged for other suppliers (see agent memory). 'Lift unit (stroke +100 mm)' is printed under Add-ons/Energy but reads as an optional accessory stroke extension, not a stated total lift_height figure -- not mapped to lift_height to avoid a misleading precise-looking number. Dimensioned drawing on p.2 (350mm/996mm/1750mm) has no clear axis labels in the extracted text -- vehicle_length/vehicle_width left null rather than guessed (both CONTEXT-level, not KO, so no image-based re-read triggered per this agent's own escalation rule). ADDENDUM (later in same continuation run): 'Mobile-Robotics-portfolio-EN.pdf' (Stäubli's own company-wide product catalog, also processed this run) explicitly lists 'PF3' (3t, drive type 'Tricycle') and 'PF3 OMNI' (3t, drive type 'Omnidirectional') as TWO SEPARATE products -- matching this datasheet's own 'Drive type: Tricycle' label for plain PF3. This is a genuine naming-ambiguity FLAG: the DB's existing single 'Stäubli PF3' row already has omnidirectional_movement=1 set (pre-existing, non-null, not touched), which is inconsistent with 'PF3' being the Tricycle variant per both sources -- it's possible the DB row was actually populated from 'PF3 OMNI' data under the 'PF3' name, or that 'PF3 OMNI' is a genuinely separate product missing from the DB entirely. Not resolved here (insufficient additional PF3 OMNI-specific numeric data was found beyond its 3t/Omnidirectional label to justify creating a confident new product row) -- flagged for Tech Lead investigation.
